headings.usage: Headers, SVI Scores, Key Figures, Brand Name (Samvedna / संवेदना)

labels.style: Hinglish bilingual labels (e.g., Aage Badhein / Continue →), Hindi subtitles under each main title.
labels.tracking: tracking-tight for headings, tracking-normal for body

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-[16px] to rounded-[20px] for major cards, rounded-full for chips/buttons
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-sm for resting cards, shadow-md on hover. The main mobile container gets a shadow-2xl for depth against the desktop background.

layouts.app_wrapper: A centered mobile frame for web view. `max-w-[420px] mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl bg-[#F7EFE2] overflow-x-hidden`. Desktop users see a phone-sized app in the center.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous internal padding for cards (p-4 to p-6) to maintain breathing room.

grids.toolkit_tiles: grid-cols-2 gap-3 or gap-4 for dashboard support directories and history.

components.header: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F7EFE2]/90 with border-b border-[#D3C7AC]. Contains logo 'Samvedna / संवेदना' and Language Toggle.
components.helpline_banner: Full width inside wrapper, bg-[#8B2A1A] text-white, prominent tel:14566 link, 24/7 indicator.
components.hero_card: bg-[#4A5A1E] text-white, rounded-[20px], p-6. Used for 'Describe a New Problem'.

buttons.primary: bg-[#B8862B] text-white rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-medium hover:bg-[#a37625] transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#7A4A12] text-white rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-medium hover:bg-[#633a0d] transition-colors
buttons.urgent: bg-[#C4694A] text-white rounded-full py-3 px-6 font-medium

components.bottom_nav: Fixed bottom, z-50, max-w-[420px] mx-auto w-full bg-white border-t border-[#D3C7AC] pb-safe. 4 items (Guidance, Thread, Helpline, Profile). Active state uses a gold (#B8862B) pill background with white text and icon.
components.otp_boxes: Flex row of 4 boxes per OTP (mobile + email). w-12 h-12 text-center text-xl border border-[#D3C7AC] rounded-xl focus:border-[#4A5A1E] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#4A5A1E].
components.status_chips: Inline-flex, rounded-full, px-3 py-1 text-xs font-medium. Colors map to SVI level.
components.svi_gauge: Visual indicator 0-100. Can be a half-doughnut chart or a segmented linear progress bar showing Low/Moderate/High/Critical zones. Highlight current score clearly.
components.case_timeline: Vertical stepper component. Green (#25C05F) checkmarks for completed steps, dashed lines connecting nodes.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards (-translate-y-1), gentle scale (scale: 0.98) on button taps.
motion.waveform: For voice intake, use CSS animations (scaleY) on small vertical bars to simulate active listening.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over the olive and red backgrounds meets APCA standards. Use white text.
accessibility.voice_assist: Include subtle audio triggers/synthesizer hooks for accessibility as requested.

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 2. Do NOT use emojis. Strict professional and compassionate iconography.

hero_image.description: Two people holding hands, conveying compassion and support. Use selectively in onboarding or the 'Support Directory' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React.js (JavaScript) application. Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Construct the layout exclusively inside a `max-w-[420px] mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl` container so it looks like a mobile app on desktop.
Ensure strict adherence to the provided color hex codes. Do NOT use generic Tailwind blues or grays.
Implement the Dual OTP flow (Mobile + Email) with a 30s resend timer.
Implement a voice intake UI with a live waveform animation.
Implement a mock SVI (Severe Vulnerability Index) assessment gauge that outputs a score 0-100.
Build the multi-step form and the counsellor portal queue as requested.
Always apply 'data-testid' attributes to key elements for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). You MUST NOT center align the app container text (no .App { text-align: center; }). Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped). NEVER use emojis for icons. Use lucide-react. Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use sonner for toasts.
